name: path-guard
description: Blocks Write, Edit and MultiEdit calls that target a path outside the project root or inside .git, plus optional deny globs.

deny_globs.title: Denied globs
deny_globs.description: Comma-separated globs Claude may not write, e.g. **/*.lock,infra/**. Matched against the path relative to the project root.

allow_outside.title: Allowed outside the project
allow_outside.description: Comma-separated absolute directories Claude may write outside the project root, e.g. /tmp. ~ is expanded.

guard_reads.title: Guard Read too
guard_reads.description: Also apply the outside-the-project and deny-glob rules to Read.
